title: McDonald's has until Jan. 5 to stop giving plastic cups to sit-in visitors: Inspectorate
title_zh: 监察部门：麦当劳必须在1月5日前停止向堂食顾客提供塑料杯。
description: The Netherlands' Human Environment and Transport Inspectorate (ILT) has imposed a penalty order on fast food chain McDonald’s for violating national rules for disposable cups.
description_zh: 荷兰人类环境与交通监察局 (ILT) 对快餐连锁店麦当劳处以罚款，原因是其违反了国家关于一次性杯子的规定。

title: Mother confirmed to be suspect in 12-year-old boy's death in Eerbeek
title_zh: 埃尔贝克一名12岁男孩死亡案中，母亲被证实为嫌疑人。

description_zh: 在对一名12岁男孩在怡保死亡事件进行调查期间，一名女子被捕。

title: The Netherlands opens free hotline for complex tax, benefits questions

description: People in the Netherlands who cannot resolve their issues with the Tax Authority or the Benefits Agency on their own can now call a free 0800 number to receive support.
description_zh: 荷兰民众如果无法自行解决与税务局或福利机构的问题，现在可以拨打免费的 0800 电话号码获得帮助。

description_zh: 周五晚上，里斯贝亨市纳绍街的一栋房屋发生火灾，一名男子受伤。

title: Vulnerable Amsterdam kids sent far from city as local youth care provider halts intake
title_zh: 由于当地青少年护理机构停止接收儿童，阿姆斯特丹一些弱势儿童被送往远离市区的地方。

title: Test set to ban trans women from women’s Olympics lacks scientific backing: Experts

description_zh: 由于新规，从 2028 年起，跨性别女性将被排除在奥运会之外。

title: Large Aalsmeer secondhand store ordered to close over presence of weapons, ammunition

description: Public satisfaction with the Jetten I Cabinet has fallen to its lowest point since Prime Minister Rob Jetten (D66) took office in February.
description_zh: 自罗布·杰滕（D66）总理于2月上任以来，公众对杰滕一世内阁的满意度已降至最低点。

title: Second person dies following workplace accident involving hazardous materials in Zwaag
title_zh: 兹瓦格发生一起涉及危险材料的工作场所事故，造成第二人死亡。

title: Dozens of Dutch soldiers can be tracked, addresses exposed using Polarsteps app
title_zh: 利用 Polarsteps 应用，可以追踪数十名荷兰士兵的行踪，并泄露他们的地址。

description_zh: 通过名为 Polarsteps 的社交旅行应用程序和名为“Follow the Money”的调查平台，数十名军人的行踪可以被准确追踪。

title: Man and woman stabbed, hospitalized following alleged dispute in Den Bosch
title_zh: 在登博斯，一男一女因疑似争执被刺伤，送医治疗。

title: Government restricts free legal aid for benefits scandal victims in fights with cities
title_zh: 政府限制向福利丑闻受害者提供免费法律援助，以对抗各城市
description: Parents harmed by the Dutch childcare benefits scandals will no longer get a free lawyer when they clash with municipal governments over practical support for the victims.

title: Online scammers finding more success targetting young adults than over-55s: Study
title_zh: 研究表明，网络诈骗分子更容易将目标锁定在年轻人身上，而不是55岁以上的人群。

title_zh: 挪威至荷兰首条直达天然气管道的建设取得进展
description: Following a successful feasibility study, Nogat, the North Sea pipeline operator, is taking the next steps in developing the first direct gas connection between Norway and the Netherlands.
description_zh: 在成功完成可行性研究后，北海管道运营商 Nogat 正在采取下一步措施，开发挪威和荷兰之间的第一条直接天然气连接。

title: Slight drop in traffic emissions as more electric cars hit Dutch roadways
title_zh: 随着更多电动汽车驶入荷兰道路，交通排放量略有下降。
description: Road traffic emitted slightly less CO2 last year than the year before, Statistics Netherlands has reported based on preliminary figures.
description_zh: 荷兰统计局根据初步数据显示，去年道路交通排放的二氧化碳略少于前一年。

title_zh: 跟踪荷兰足球传奇人物马尔科·范巴斯滕的女子被送往精神病院接受治疗
description: The District Court has suspended the pre-trial detention of a 47-year-old woman who is suspected of stalking former professional footballer Marco van Basten.

description_zh: 周五上午，一名12岁男孩的尸体在海尔德兰省埃尔贝克被发现。警方报告称，一名成年人因涉嫌与此案有关而被捕。

description_zh: 据该研究平台称，俄罗斯驻海牙大使馆主要充当宣传渠道，并利用“当地扩音器”传播其叙事。

title: Four children removed from Friesland care home; Worker, 18, suspected of sex crimes

description: The Public Prosecution Service (OM) suspects an 18-year-old man from the municipality of Noardeast-Fryslân of child sex abuse crimes.

description: The District Court in Amsterdam has sentenced 31-year-old Alicia R. to four years in prison and mandatory psychiatric treatment at a TBS facility for the fatal stabbing of a 77-year-old landlord.

title: Turning on your hazards for a quick parcel pick up does not equal free parking: Court

description_zh: 即使你打开危险警示灯把车停在停车位上，而乘客跳下车快速取包裹，也不意味着你无需支付停车费。

title: Court releases Hoofddorp man in child torture case linked to violent online group
title_zh: 法院释放了一名与暴力网络团伙有关联的霍夫多普男子，该男子涉嫌虐待儿童，被控与该团伙有关联。
description: Mert A., a 23-year-old from Hoofddorp who is suspected of being a member of a violent online group and child abuse, has been released.
description_zh: 来自霍夫多普的 23 岁男子 Mert A. 因涉嫌参与暴力网络组织和虐待儿童而被释放。

title: Mayor closes Overasselt home hit in apparent gang shooting; Guard killed, two cops shot
title_zh: 市长关闭了奥弗阿塞尔特住宅，该住宅疑似发生帮派枪击事件；一名保安被杀，两名警察中枪。
description: The house in Overasselt that was attacked by dozens of armed men on Tuesday has been closed for a year by the mayor’s orders.
description_zh: 周二遭到数十名武装人员袭击的奥弗阿塞尔特的那栋房子，已根据市长的命令关闭一年。

title: All national, international trains scrapped on Sept. 9 except Amsterdam-Schiphol
title_zh: 除阿姆斯特丹至史基浦机场的列车外，所有国内和国际列车均于9月9日停运。
description: The NS has confirmed that, with the exception of some trains to Schiphol, there will be no NS trains running in the Netherlands during the national 24-hour public transport strike next Wednesday.
description_zh: 荷兰国家铁路公司 (NS) 已确认，除部分开往史基浦机场的列车外，下周三全国公共交通 24 小时罢工期间，荷兰境内将没有 NS 列车运行。

title: Prosecutors ordered to name doctors who questioned parents' role in teen's euthanasia
title_zh: 检察官被勒令公布质疑父母在青少年安乐死中所扮演角色的医生姓名

description_zh: 公共检察署（OM）必须公布质疑父母角色的医生名单。

title: Ajax, PSV, Feyenoord make deadline day moves as eventful transfer window closes
title_zh: 阿贾克斯、埃因霍温和费耶诺德在转会窗口关闭前夕纷纷出手，精彩纷呈的转会窗口即将落下帷幕。
description: The big three of Dutch football, Ajax, PSV, and Feyenoord, made purchases or sales on the final day of the Dutch transfer window.
description_zh: 荷兰足球三大豪门阿贾克斯、埃因霍温和费耶诺德在荷兰转会窗口的最后一天都进行了引援或出售。

title: Video: Fatal stabbing leaves Romanian man dead in Hoogeveen; Two others arrested
title_zh: 视频：罗马尼亚男子在霍格文遭致命刺伤身亡；另有两人被捕
description: Two were arrested in Hoogeveen, Drenthe, on Wednesday after a victim was found dead following a suspected stabbing.
description_zh: 周三，在德伦特省霍赫芬，一名受害者被发现死于疑似刺伤事件后，两名嫌疑人被捕。

title: Officers arrest man, 18,  who was in possession of a loaded firearm at Schiphol
title_zh: 警方在史基浦机场逮捕了一名18岁男子，该男子当时持有已上膛的枪支。

description_zh: 周三，一名18岁男子在史基浦机场被捕，此前警方在搜身时发现他携带一把装有子弹的武器。

title: National water shortage over; Effects felt for months, or even years, says Dutch gov’t
title_zh: 荷兰政府称，全国缺水危机已解除；其影响将持续数月甚至数年。
description: The national water shortage in the Netherlands is over.
description_zh: 荷兰全国性的水资源短缺问题已经结束。

description_zh: 荷兰官方宣布已解除缺水危机，但此前导致船屋搁浅、货船部分装载的干旱……

title: Inspectors allow only Dutch online abortion service to continue
title_zh: 检查人员只允许荷兰的在线堕胎服务继续运营。

description_zh: 荷兰医疗卫生监察机构发现，该国唯一的在线堕胎服务机构未能履行其护理职责……

title: Illegal casinos hijack thousands of Dutch websites
title_zh: 非法赌场劫持了数千个荷兰网站
description: At least 1,000 legitimate Dutch and European websites, many belonging to companies, charities and freelancers, have been quietly turned into...
description_zh: 至少有 1000 个合法的荷兰和欧洲网站，其中许多属于公司、慈善机构和自由职业者，已被悄悄地变成了……

title: Dutch authorities warn of "rapidly changing" cybercrime; 2.5 million victims last year
title_zh: 荷兰当局警告称，网络犯罪“变化迅速”；去年受害者达250万人。
description: “The cyber threat to the Netherlands is changing rapidly,” the police and Public Prosecution Service (OM) said in their biannual Cybercrime Landscape Netherlands
description_zh: 荷兰警方和公共检察署（OM）在其半年一度的《荷兰网络犯罪概况》报告中指出：“荷兰面临的网络威胁正在迅速变化。”

title: Chemical pollution worsens at Dutch swim sites; Dog flea collar pesticide often found
title_zh: 荷兰游泳场所化学污染加剧；常发现狗用跳蚤项圈杀虫剂。
description: Together with blue-green algae and bacteria, many Dutch water bodies increasingly contain an amount of chemical substances over the allowed levels.
description_zh: 除了蓝藻和细菌之外，许多荷兰水体中的化学物质含量也日益超过允许的水平。

title: There is now 42 percent less work for freelancers than 2 years ago
title_zh: 现在自由职业者的工作量比两年前减少了42%。

description_zh: 根据人力资源服务提供商 HeadFirst 和劳动力市场数据公司发布的年度报告，目前荷兰自由职业者的工作机会比 2024 年底减少了 42%。

title: More seniors receiving care at home; 20 percent of nursing homes have fewer residents
title_zh: 更多老年人选择居家养老；20%的养老院入住率下降。
description: More and more elderly people in the Netherlands only stay at care institutions for short periods of time, causing the number of clients to drop in 1 out of 5 such businesses.
description_zh: 荷兰越来越多的老年人只在养老机构短期居住，导致五分之一的养老机构客户数量下降。

title: Casinos hijack over 1,000 unsuspecting website owners, flooding them with illegal ads
title_zh: 赌场劫持了超过1000个毫无戒心的网站所有者，向他们投放大量非法广告。

title: West Nile virus infections confirmed in nine people in the Netherlands
title_zh: 荷兰确诊9例西尼罗河病毒感染病例
description: The West Nile virus has been confirmed in nine people in the Netherlands since the start of the summer, according to the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM).
description_zh: 据荷兰国家公共卫生与环境研究所 (RIVM) 称，自夏季开始以来，荷兰已有 9 人确诊感染西尼罗河病毒。

title_zh: 荷兰央行将裁减290个全职岗位，作为重组计划的一部分
description: A total of 290 full-time jobs are being scrapped at De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) as part of the reorganization that was announced last year, a spokesperson for the Dutch central bank confirmed after

description_zh: 海牙一家法院周四裁定，公共检察署（OM）必须交出嫌疑人的姓名……

title: Student room shortage stays above 20,000 despite new builds
title_zh: 尽管新建宿舍楼很多，但学生宿舍缺口仍然超过2万间。

description_zh: 荷兰越来越多的学生选择住在父母家，或者放弃寻找住处……

description_zh: 据估计，荷兰有250万人成为网络犯罪或网络诈骗、欺骗或其他形式的侵害的受害者……

title_zh: 兔场因虐待视频面临起诉

title_zh: 研究人员发现，荷兰的游泳用水污染日益严重。

description_zh: 根据一家环保组织的最新研究，荷兰的游泳用水仍然经常受到化学物质和细菌的污染……

title: Little help for girls in NL caught up in crime: study

description_zh: 对于卷入荷兰刑事司法系统的女孩和年轻女性，几乎没有任何帮助……

description_zh: 警方在海尔德兰省中心城镇及其周边多个地点进行搜查时，发现了多件武器……

title: Tech companies massively buying second-hand Dutch books to train AI

description: Tech companies are buying second-hand Dutch books on a large scale to train their AI language models,
description_zh: 科技公司正在大规模购买二手荷兰语书籍，以训练其人工智能语言模型。

title: About 1,300 construction projects set to be halted due to suspension of inspector
title_zh: 由于检查员被停职，约1300个建筑项目将被迫停工。
description: The Association of Dutch municipalities (VNG) has warned that many construction projects will have to be halted due to the suspension of an important inspector.
description_zh: 荷兰市政协会 (VNG) 警告称，由于一名重要督察被停职，许多建设项目将不得不停工。
